Book correction: The table and Figure 1.8 print \sinh 3 as 10.03 (and \sinh(-3) as -10.03). The correct value is \sinh 3 = \dfrac{e^{3} - e^{-3}}{2} \approx \dfrac{20.0855 - 0.0498}{2} \approx 10.0179 \approx 10.02 So the entries should be 10.02 and -10.02. (Do not confuse it with \cosh 3 \approx 10.07.) Our figure plots 10.02.
